text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—The Fan Appreciation Festival.
An event where fans are invited into Tracen Academy for various attractions, sports, and more, but...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Turbo can't play sports with annoying rules! 'Cause I can't remember 'em!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, the sport Twin Turbo took part in was—

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
All right, even in a car race,
I'm going full throttle from the start!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Vroom vroom, vrooooooooom!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"It was esports. Other Umamusume skilled in
car racing and video games also gathered
at the public road course along the bay area."

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, what's this? If it were a mobile game,
I could do it with one finger. The controls are so hard...

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text:
'Iron Will' right here...
Huh, where's the command?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Got passed, dammit! I'm way faster in motorcycle games, though.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Let's go into second—no, third gear!
Wait, this game doesn't have gears?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: While many Umamusume were struggling—

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
We did it!
Pole position!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WAAAAAAAAAAAH!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After setting an impressive top time in the qualifiers,
Twin Turbo takes the front row in the finals alongside her rivals—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Second position, huh. However, on this course,
starting on the outside gives an advantage.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
I will decide it at the first corner.
The mission is—victory.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —Symboli Kris S. Known as a consummate professional, she executes every mission with absolute certainty.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Glory—to our "Brazilian brethren."

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
A compatriot from Brazil?
Kris S, who is that?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Symboli has an expert car racer
who was born in Brazil.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
I was taught—by that Umamusume.
To repay one's debts of gratitude.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A running style taught directly in Brazil, home to countless race champions...
She looks to be quite the formidable rival.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
A master...? Turbo doesn't know
anyone like that. But...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
I won't lose if it's a game!
Turbo at full throttle!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Pip, pip, pip, TWEEET!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The red lights illuminate—
and then black out!
The curtain has risen on the final race.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
All right, the start was perfect! I'm gonna
lead all the way to victory just like this!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Twin Turbo goes all out right from the start.
However, Symboli Kris S makes precise,
frequent inputs on her controller, and...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Vroom, vroom vroom, vroom...!)

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Wh-What's with that delicate acceleration...???

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Straight from Brazil—
Stomping Accel.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Repeatedly feathering the accelerator through the corner, and then—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Vroom vroom, vrooooom...!!)

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Control... the traction.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Ooooh!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A shadow loomed behind Twin Turbo's car.
Her opponent got right on her tail, but—

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
"Even so... Turbo won't lose,
won't lose, won't lose!
I'm gonna front-run all the way to the end—!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And the result is—

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Goal! The winner is Symboli Kris S!
It's Symboli Kris S!

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Twin Turbo's no-pit strategy backfired.
Her tires gave out, and she lost all her momentum...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
U-U-Uuuu... Turbo is so frustrated!
Frustrated, frustrated, so frustrated~~!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
"It wasn't supposed to end up like this~...
Turbo is super good at racing games..."

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Waaaahhh, waaaahhh!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Twin Turbo wept uncontrollably, heedless of onlookers.
And then—

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, Turbo can't let it end like this!
Turbo's gonna practice!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: From now on, I'm gonna practice like crazy every single day, and next year, I'm gonna win!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: WOOOOOOOO!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Twin Turbo dashes off, swearing her revenge.
More than that, though...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Part of me wished she would direct that passion toward the Twinkle Series instead.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The two engaged in a fierce dead heat, and—

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Taaaaaaaaahhhhh!!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
No way... In an ordinary race—
she should be at her limit. What is this cornering...?

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: Go, Twin Turbo!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
That's the spirit, Twin Turbo!
Show me what lies beyond your limits!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Twin Turbo answered the cheers
of her many fans—

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Twin Turbo, pole to win!
A wire-to-wire victory in commanding fashion!

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text: "Now that's a textbook winning pattern! Despite being fiercely pursued, she never relinquished the lead even once!"

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
How about that, Trainer!
Since it's a game, it's totally fine no matter how fast I fly!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
I see... In auto racing,
running out of stamina—simply does not happen.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —Congratulations, Twin Turbo.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The two shake hands. Twin Turbo vigorously
pumped Symboli Kris S's hand up and down—

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Still, Kris S was super strong too!
She might even be, like, the second strongest in the world after Turbo!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Thank you.
However, I am—not number two.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Symboli has—an even faster racer.
A master from Brazil.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Ah, you mentioned that earlier too, right?
Then Turbo wants to race that Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! Turbo wants to go to Brazil.
I wanna go, I wanna go, take me with you~!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Heh, in an era like this...
we might just be able to meet online.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Or perhaps... they might come to this country.
Yes—somewhere around Fukushima.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Oooh, really?! Then maybe
we can run together on the racetrack too!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Turbo is looking forward to the day I can race against her!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Twin Turbo claimed a glorious victory—
dreaming of the day she'd finally encounter
the Symboli she had yet to meet.
